name: TextInput
description: SEED contract for the CARBON round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: @carbon/react@1.112.0 + @carbon/styles@1.111.0 (pinned, examples/carbon/PROVENANCE.md). size xs|sm|md|lg, ALL FOUR verified distinct by live probe (24/32/40/48px). The recon predicted xs might not exist because the compiled CSS ships no `.cds--text-input--xs` rule — it does not, and the height still moves: Carbon routes control sizing through the SHARED `.cds--layout--size-*` classes and the :root layout tokens, not through per-component size rules. `invalid`/`warn` are DEFERRED BY NAME from round 1 (they add a validation subtree and a second border plane).
